FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Crafted Timberworks, we specialize in custom woodworking and carpentry, primarily focusing on interior projects. Our operations include the design and construction of bespoke furniture, cabinetry, and other interior installations, serving both residential and commercial clients. We adhere to rigorous safety standards, ensuring that our workshops are equipped with modern, well-maintained equipment and a comprehensive safety training program for our employees. We prioritize dust control measures and proper ventilation while avoiding the use of overly flammable or toxic chemicals, which helps us mitigate fire and health hazards. As a small team operating in a commercial zone with the necessary fire protection, we are committed to delivering high-quality craftsmanship while maintaining a safe and compliant working environment.
